desc.en: Free public DNS Resolver, which is fast and secure (encrypt your DNS query), provided by Cloudflare. Useful to bypass your internet provider's DNS blocking, prevent DNS query spying, and [to block adult & malware content](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/1.1.1.1-for-families). It can also be used [via API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/encrypted-dns/dns-over-https/make-api-requests). Note: Just a DNS resolver, not a DNS hoster.
desc.zh: 免费公共 DNS 解析器，快速且安全（加密你的 DNS 查询），由 Cloudflare 提供。可用于绕过互联网提供商的 DNS 封锁、防止 DNS 查询被窥探，以及[屏蔽成人和恶意软件内容](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/1.1.1.1-for-families)。也可[通过 API](https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/encrypted-dns/dns-over-https/make-api-requests) 使用。注意：它只是 DNS 解析器，不是 DNS 托管商。

desc.en: Free DNS service with API and lots of other free DNS features included.
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 服务，包含 API 和许多其他免费 DNS 功能。

desc.en: Free DNS hosting up to 1 domain with 50 records
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管，最多 1 个域名、50 条记录

desc.en: Free DNS hosting with API support, designed with security in mind. Runs on open-source software and is supported by [SSE](https://www.securesystems.de/).
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管，支持 API，在设计上注重安全。运行于开源软件，由 [SSE](https://www.securesystems.de/) 提供支持。

desc.en: Free DNS hosting service with Dynamic DNS Support
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管服务，支持 Dynamic DNS

desc.en: Free DNS hosting.
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管。

desc.en: Free DDNS with up to 5 domains on the free tier. With configuration guides for various setups.
desc.zh: 免费 DDNS，免费套餐最多支持 5 个域名。提供各种部署方式的配置指南。

desc.en: Free DDNS service with [API support](https://dynv6.com/docs/apis) and management of a lot of dns record types (like CNAME, MX, SPF, SRV, TXT and others).
desc.zh: 免费 DDNS 服务，支持 [API](https://dynv6.com/docs/apis)，可管理多种 DNS 记录类型（如 CNAME、MX、SPF、SRV、TXT 等）。

desc.en: Free DNS hosting. Also, provide free subdomains based on numerous public user [contributed domains](https://freedns.afraid.org/domain/registry/). Get free subdomains from the "Subdomains" menu after signing up.
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管。还基于众多公开用户[贡献的域名](https://freedns.afraid.org/domain/registry/)提供免费子域名。注册后从“Subdomains”菜单获取免费子域名。

desc.en: Free DNS hosting for up to 3 domains and DNSSEC support
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管，最多支持 3 个域名，支持 DNSSEC

desc.en: Free DNS hosting from Hetzner with API support.
desc.zh: Hetzner 提供的免费 DNS 托管，支持 API。

desc.en: Free DNS hosting by Huawei
desc.zh: 华为提供的免费 DNS 托管

desc.en: Free `.localcert.net` subdomains compatible with public CAs for use with-in private networks
desc.zh: 免费的 `.localcert.net` 子域名，兼容公共 CA，可在私有网络内使用

desc.en: Free DNS hosting, three domains, all features with reasonable limits
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管，三个域名，包含所有功能并有合理限制

desc.en: Free DNS. No limit on the number of domains
desc.zh: 免费 DNS。域名数量不限

desc.en: DNS-based firewall, 300K free queries monthly
desc.zh: 基于 DNS 的防火墙，每月 300K 次免费查询

desc.en: Free DDNS service without registration, tracking, logging or advertising. No limit to domains.
desc.zh: 免费 DDNS 服务，无需注册、跟踪、日志或广告。域名数量不限。

desc.en: a dynamic DNS service that allows up to 3 hostnames free with confirmation every 30 days
desc.zh: 动态 DNS 服务，免费支持最多 3 个主机名，每 30 天需确认一次

desc.en: Free DNS service that when queried with a hostname with an embedded IP address returns that IP address.
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 服务，当查询包含内嵌 IP 地址的主机名时，返回该 IP 地址。

desc.en: Free DNS hosting for 5 domains.
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管，支持 5 个域名。

desc.en: Free DNS hosting with Dynamic DNS Support.
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管，支持 Dynamic DNS。

desc.en: Free DNS hosting service with instant DNS propagation. Free plan: 1 DNS zone (domain name) with up to 10 DNS records.
desc.zh: 免费 DNS 托管服务，DNS 即时生效。免费套餐：1 个 DNS 区域（域名），最多 10 条 DNS 记录。
